rows.heading: # VisualCore — 25 standalone iOS app implementation manuals
rows.note: The manuals are no longer plans for standalone apps but the design input of experiences A01-A25 (ADR-0009 D-01). They remain implementation plans, not evidence. Byte-identical copy of VisualCore-25-App-Specs-Index.md.

rows.heading: ## Contents
rows.note: List of the 25 manuals with family and brainstorm rank; carried as A01-A25 in docs/catalog/experience-catalog.json. A01-A03 are sealed, A04 is partial, A05-A25 are not started.

rows.heading: ## Recommended use
rows.note: Audit first (F00) and one narrow first app (A01) were done. Separate app repositories gave way to the monorepo (ADR-0007) and to one app target (ADR-0009 D-01); per-app device validation to D-07.

rows.heading: ## Shared technical rules
rows.note: Still binding: one ANGLE path, no ProjectM linkage in experiences, macOS and Xcode for builds and graphics QA, no other-app audio capture, no automatic live wallpaper, no unverified scientific or precision claims.

rows.heading: ## Source and command documentation
rows.note: Reference links. Both original sources (README.md, AppsBrainstorm.md) are archived next to this file.

rows.heading: ## Manifest checks
rows.note: The counts hold for the archived files: 25 manuals, 16,168 lines, 1,347,611 bytes. Source hashes were sealed by desktop_runbook.py validate (gate F01, check runbook-validate) and by planning_archive.py verify.
